title: "Results"
format: html
---

These are the tables and figures produced by running `R/main.R` on the study data. They were exported to `tables/` and `figures/` and are shown here as saved; this page does not rerun any analysis. The investigators have confirmed that these results are cleared for public release; they were published in *Open Forum Infectious Diseases* [@yoon2022antibody].

::: callout-note
All analyses were exploratory, with no correction for multiple comparisons. ROC curves and cutpoints were estimated and evaluated on the same data. The bootstrap AUC confidence intervals involve random resampling and can differ slightly between runs.
:::

## Antibody levels by case status

![](../figures/faceted_titer_plot.png){fig-alt="Seven side-by-side panels, one per antibody (GXM-IgG, GXM-IgM, IgG1, IgG2, IgM, Lam-IgG, Lam-IgM), each comparing cases with controls on a log-scaled y-axis. Each panel shows a grey violin of the distribution, a black bar at the median, individual participants as points colored by transplanted organ and shaped by sex, and a Wilcoxon p-value at the top."}
